summary.text: Larry Grooms is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 37, which covers Berkeley and Charleston Counties, serving since November 4, 1997.
He chairs the Senate Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Grooms is a businessman, and his official page lists a B.S. from Clemson University in 1987.
He has served on the Board of Visitors of Charleston Southern University since 1996 and on the executive committee of the Berkeley County Republican Party from 1996 to 2008.
He has been in the Senate since November 4, 1997.
His page lists legislator-of-the-year honors from groups including the South Carolina Farm Bureau (2005) and the South Carolina Fraternal Order of Police (2009).
